allowed_production_scope: Only lib/material-fact-currency-review.ts was changed in OWN, byte-copied first from CODE exact95; no source/money/event module changes.
fixed_dependency_method: Both red and green reconstruct lib from git archive of exact95 and overlay only the selected currency file; the five old script suites use the same exact95 lib/scripts plus only the new currency overlay.

grammar.operation: An anchored foreign marker immediately followed by horizontal/neutral punctuation bridge, then 折合 or 折算为/折算為, then an explicit RMB result marker.
grammar.explicit_target_markers: 人民币 / 人民幣 / RMB / CNY / ¥ / ￥(NFKC), attached in before, inside the parsed token, or immediately after the token.
grammar.scope: Remove one contiguous source-currency+conversion prefix on the already folded detection edge; preserve all other prefix markers and all suffix tests. A bare 元 does not authorize the exception. No sentence/newline/person/numeral prose is allowed inside this finite conversion bridge.
grammar.positions: All folding and removal affect a derived detection string only. Original raw, candidate value/quote, representation, source and Unicode codepoint spans stay unchanged.
grammar.not_performed: No FX rate calculation or numeric conversion; the RMB amount must already appear in the source.

positive_coverage: 美元折合人民币4000元 and 美元折算为人民币4000元, direct anchor and full/cropped quotes through fresh runtime and source review.
Traditional markers/numerals, fullwidth currency codes, Cf controls, horizontal spaces and neutral parentheses use detection copies only.
Explicit RMB appears outside or inside the value; postfix named RMB and a bare Arabic crop can use an immediately attached explicit target marker.
A source500美元 and explicit target人民币4000元 retain separate anchor meanings; target4000 stays exact, source500 remains unavailable.
Known historical exact reads preserve the explicitly stated RMB result; historical unsupported/null is never auto-upgraded; original source/state/raw/history remain unchanged.
negative_controls: RMB marker without a conversion operator does not wash away USD; 计价/折算 without 为 are outside the new exception.
Bare 元 without named RMB, reverse RMB-to-foreign, trailing foreign markers, an additional prefix foreign marker and conflicting currency after the same wage noun all remain null.
Another event, subject, clause boundary or newline cannot lend its conversion to the original USD amount. Existing separated-event RMB remains exact.
Full values still containing a foreign literal remain conservative unsupported under the literal parser; no long mixed-currency value syntax was broadened.
limits: This author test is synthetic local runtime/source/history execution, not HTTP, model inference, new independent materials, a full project check, CI, legal classification or production calculation authorization.

No exception crosses newline or a clause; source review retains existing event-local policies. Ordinary newline-separated RMB can still be usable under the pre-existing independent-event policy, not this conversion exception.
Only the listed finite words 折合 and 折算为/為 are added. Other descriptions are not claimed to be completely recognized.
The real currency conversion outcome is read from the source; its economic correctness or rate is not verified by this guard.
